rationale_bullets: 2025 Nevada QBs: 10 TD / 17 INT - the worst ratio in FBS; team PASS grade p1 (second p1 of this round after NIU).
Jones returns (202 snaps, 49.8 -> 42.5 adj; 1,019 @ 64%, 6-8 as a true FR forced early) vs Duncan (UCLA: one career start - vs Ohio St, 21-34-235; 'accurate') + Bianco.
New system entirely: run-heavy -> Air Raid/spread under Bartolone (ex-Colorado pass-game coord).
18 L = NIU/Ball St tier: real FBS snaps that argue down + a P4 backup lottery ticket + age-curve upside on Jones.
data_gaps: battle decided in a brand-new system

rationale_bullets: Turner returns (70.0 -> 61.1 adj; 5.1 ypc) but injuries/fumbles限held him to 14-26 combined rushes over six late games - durability unproven.
Ramseur (72.3/140, team-leading 683) expired; the depth is a JC add (220-lb Jackson, feed-gap) + power-flash Kelley (23 att).
Team RUN grade was p12 - the ground game was bad even before the losses.
14 = SacSt/EMU tier.
The top five receivers left and they combined for only 1,259 yards - the room was already RECV p7.
Leading returner M.Brown had 16 catches (64.1/177 -> 60.4 adj); the TE room is a 4-catch rFr (Asiasi) and a 6'9" project.
The rebuild is FCS volume (Doss 1,107 @ 19.1 at Towson; Morgan 607 at Idaho St - Athlon WR1 but a feed-gap) + the resolved NIU ghost Givens (100 yds there).
Choate's 'most improved unit' is a coach quote; the evidence says 12 = Ball St tier. L: new Air Raid system could feed anyone.

Both starting tackles entered the portal as Withdrawn/no-dest and STAY (double override, both prints): Cochnauer (79.5/640, 10 st, 4th-Tm MWC - the best OL tape of the MWC round) and Foster (62.8/738, 12 st).
The Memphis-via-Kennesaw pair adds real interior history: Norcross (71.5 arrival tape; 12 KSU starts) + Newman (66.9; 15 KSU starts).
Losses (Madrigal 748, Grabowski 678, T.Scott) are real but the returning RBLK was p79.
22 = clear best OL of the MWC round (> Toledo/SJSU 14), below the CMU/WMU 28 tier.

LaBarbera is the best returning defender graded in the G5 rounds: 91.0 on 668 snaps (88.8 MWC-adj), 12 st, 87 tkl, 18 TFL, 1st-Tm MWC, DPOY candidate with an NFL future - 'we couldn't block the guy' (opposing coach).
The supporting rotation is real: Va'a (66.9 adj), Paine (72.1), Vaughan (65.5, yr4 override), M.Williams (yr4 override), rFr K.Brown (74.2 flash).
Maldonado (78.1/634) leaving for Ole Miss is the cap; Witte/Ropati interiors also gone.
26 = best front of the MWC round; above KSU 22/CMU 24, below BGSU 34. PS: 'Choate's top DL' since arriving.
Combs (521 snaps, no-dest GONE), Jackson (402 -> James Madison), Harnetiaux (298 -> Rice) - the whole rotation leaves.
Smith is the room: 65.4/280 (60.7 adj), 8 starts and team-leader status before a mid-season OFY - Rojas-pattern credit for his level, but he is one player.
Naborne-Owens' CSU tape is below-average (55.3/299 -> 50.6 adj) despite the 'NFL body'; Utu is a 49-snap sample.
12 L: just above NIU's 10; Choate's 'weakness to a strength' is aspiration, not evidence.
data_gaps: two-deep after the top three is rFr/FR

rationale_bullets: Loses an excellent top four (Odums 81.7/696, Kenion 76.1/730, Rhambo 70.6/579 no-dest, McDonald) from a COV p64 unit.

But the 2026 room has the most real evidence of the MWC round: Walker (61.3 adj/362, true-FR buzz), Snelling (73.8 adj - best returning grade), B.Turner (67.9/306), plus FBS-tape imports Scott (EMU: 59.7 adj/504, 10 st) and Turner-Gooden (SJSU: 69.0 adj/342 - the two-sided-miss resolution).
Bridges (Arkansas, 6'4") and Webb (Boise) add pedigree depth.
18 = KSU tier; > SJSU/NIU 12.
McFadden is a real FBS kicker (19-25, L/50, 20-20 PAT; yr4 override, two prints).
The punting job is a total void: two Australian freshmen (Baulch has never punted a college game - Aussie-rules convert) + a HS recruit, replacing Ettridge's 44.7/41.0 net.
Return games thin: Woods (first Nevada KR TD since 2015) + no-stats PR Robinson (yr4 override).
16: K floor keeps it off the bottom; SPEC p13 as-played and the P void cap it.
